title: React.js Conf 2015 - Beyond the DOM: How Netflix plans to enhance your television experience
summary: Jafar Husain of Netflix explains at React.js Conf 2015 how Netflix runs React-style rendering without the DOM on smart TVs and game consoles. It uses a canvas-like API for performance.
why: Cited as the primary source on React with a custom rendering backend and on Netflix's Gibbon engine.

quote.text: There's an interesting video by Netflix where they discuss using React in their stack.
